meta.title: ft_transcendence
meta.description: Real-time Pong with friends, tournaments and chat.

common.networkError: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

landing.tagline: Real-time Pong. Challenge friends, climb the ladder, win the bracket.
landing.localLink: Or play a local game on this keyboard, no account needed

online.title: Online 1v1
online.body: Quick match against a player at your level, with a server that keeps it fair.

tournaments.title: Tournaments
tournaments.body: Four to eight players, a live bracket and one champion.

friends.title: Friends and chat
friends.body: See who is online, send a message, invite them to a match.

local.title: Local play
local.body: Two players, one keyboard. Pick the speed and the points to win.

auth.loginSubtitle: Welcome back. Use your username or email.
auth.signupSubtitle: Pick a username other players will see.
auth.usernameHint: 3 to 30 characters: letters, numbers, dots and underscores.
auth.acceptTerms: By creating an account you accept the {terms} and the {privacy}.

strength.label: Password strength
strength.0: Too short. Use at least 8 characters.
strength.2: Fair. Add a symbol or a number.

errors.invalidCredentials: That username or password is wrong. Check both and try again.
errors.usernameTaken: That username is taken. Try another.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Log in instead.
errors.invalidUsername: Use 3 to 30 letters, numbers, dots or underscores.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.googleUnavailable: Google sign-in isn't set up on this server yet.

auth.twoFactorSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.twoFactorWrong: That code is wrong or has expired. Enter the newest code from your app.
auth.twoFactorLocked: Too many wrong codes. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
auth.sessionExpiredBody: You were signed out. Log in again to continue where you left off.
auth.googleFailed: Google sign-in didn't finish. Try again, or use your username and password.

lobby.title: LOBBY
lobby.privateRoomBody: Play a friend with a room code.
lobby.noMatches: No matches yet. Your history appears here after your first game.
lobby.noFriends: No friends yet. Find players on the Friends page.
lobby.loadError: Couldn't load this. The rest of the page still works.

matchmaking.searchingBody: Matching you with a player. Press Esc to cancel.
matchmaking.waitingRoom: Waiting for a friend to join
matchmaking.shareCode: Share this code with your friend:
matchmaking.timeoutBody: Nobody is searching right now. Try again, or invite a friend to a private room.
matchmaking.disconnected: Lost connection to the game server.
matchmaking.alreadyConnected: You're already in a game in another tab. Close it, then try again.
matchmaking.roomNotFound: That room doesn't exist or is full.
matchmaking.readyTimeout: Not everyone was ready in time.

game.controlsBody: Move your paddle up and down.
game.onlineKeepsRunning: Online matches keep running while this menu is open.
game.reconnectOutcome: If they don't return in {s}s, you win the match.
game.forfeitedOnDisconnect: You were disconnected for too long, so the match was forfeited.

local.title: LOCAL GAME
local.subtitle: Two players on one keyboard.
local.aiSubtitle: Play against the computer. It reacts like a person: not instantly, and not always right.

tournament.title: TOURNAMENT
tournament.needMore: Needs at least {n} players to start.
tournament.waitingHost: Waiting for the host to start.

profile.blockConfirm: Block {name}? They can't send you requests or messages, and they leave your friends.
profile.notFoundBody: Check the username and try again.
profile.noHistoryBody: Matches show up here once they are played.
profile.friendsPrivateBody: Only {name} can see who they're friends with.

friends.title: FRIENDS
friends.noResults: No player matches “{q}”. Usernames are exact, check the spelling.
friends.empty: You haven't added anyone yet. Search for a username above.

chat.title: CHAT
chat.comingSoon: Messages arrive in the next update. You can already invite friends to a match from the lobby.
chat.emptyBody: Start one from a friend's profile or the friends list.
chat.pickBody: Choose someone on the left to read and send messages.
chat.firstMessage: Say hello. This is the start of your conversation.
chat.blockedNotice: You blocked this player. Unblock them to send messages.
chat.inviteSent: You invited them to a game

settings.title: SETTINGS
settings.avatarHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB.
settings.avatarTooLarge: That image is larger than 2 MB.
settings.avatarWrongType: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
settings.displayNameHint: Others see this name. Changing it changes your profile link.
settings.emailReadonly: Email can't be changed here yet.
settings.twoFactorBody: Ask for a code from your authenticator app when you log in.
settings.step1: 1. Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or copy the key.
settings.backupCodesBody: Each code works once if you lose your phone. Store them somewhere safe; they won't be shown again.
settings.apiKeysBody: Keys give read access to the public API. Treat them like passwords.
settings.newKeyWarning: Copy this key now. You won't see it again.
settings.revokeKeyConfirm: Revoke {name}? Apps using it stop working immediately.
settings.crtBody: Scanlines, vignette and static over the screen.
settings.reducedMotionBody: Turn off flicker, pulses and transitions.
settings.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
settings.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
settings.revokeOthersBody: Every other device will be logged out. This device stays logged in.
settings.othersRevoked: Logged out of every other session.
settings.tooManyKeys: You can have up to 10 keys. Revoke one first.
settings.noKeysBody: Create one above to use the public API.

system.notFoundLine: This ball went out of bounds
system.notFoundBody: The page you asked for doesn't exist. Nothing you did is lost.
system.errorBody: The page hit an error. Your account and matches are safe.

status.title: STATUS
status.subtitle: Live health of ft_transcendence.
status.unreachable: Can't reach the status service. The site may be down for maintenance.

data.exportBody: One JSON file with your profile, sign-in methods, sessions, friends, blocks, matches, tournaments, messages and API keys (names only).
data.deleteBody: Deletes your profile, friends, messages, API keys and sign-in methods. Your past matches stay in your opponents' history as "Deleted player". This can't be undone.
data.deleteConfirm: Everything listed above is deleted immediately and you are logged out.
data.reauth: For your safety, log in again first. Then you have 10 minutes to delete your account.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.subtitle: Ranked by wins, then win rate.
leaderboard.emptyBody: Finish a match to get on the board.
leaderboard.unranked: You're not ranked yet: finish a match to appear here.

shutout.title: Shutout
shutout.body: Win a match without conceding a point.
